title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons and Changes to the Base Contract
content:
A rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons is co-terminous with its base contract: it follows the base contract's term and ends when the base contract ends.

## Renewal

When the base contract renews or late-renews and the rider is one that renews with the base, the rider renews for the same new term without a new waiting period, and its term cap restarts. A rider renews only while its status is active or waiting period, as Bridgewell's records of the rider show.

## Ending with the base

When the base contract is cancelled, expires, is voided or converts, the rider ends the same day with the status ended with base.

## Conversion of a real estate contract

A rider on a converted real estate contract does not carry over to the new homeowner service contract. The customer may add it there as a new rider with a new waiting period.

## Ownership transfer of a rental property

On a rental property ownership transfer, the rider moves with the base contract when the rider is one that is transferable with the base.

## Base contract events and the rider

| Base contract event | Rider status before | Effect on the rider |
|---|---|---|
| Renews or late-renews | Active or waiting period | Renews for the same new term; no new waiting period; term cap restarts |
| Renews | Removed | Does not renew |
| Cancelled, expires, voided or converts | Active or waiting period | Ends the same day, status ended with base |
| Real estate contract converts to a homeowner service contract | Any | Does not carry over; may be added as a new rider with a new waiting period |
| Rental property ownership transfer | Any held rider | Moves with the base contract (every rider is published as transferable) |

**Hypothetical case.** A buyer's real estate contract with a Bridgewell Well Pump Rider converts to a homeowner service contract. The rider ends with the converted contract; if the customer adds a Well Pump Rider to the new homeowner service contract, it is a new rider that serves a new waiting period.
